skill.name: tiktok-ad-tracker-monitor
skill.description: Research TikTok ad activity and compare changes through repeated PipiAds searches. Persistent monitor tasks are available only for Facebook advertisers and stores, when the user also requests that coverage.
skill.summary: Compare TikTok ad activity with dated PipiAds searches and review Facebook monitoring separately when requested.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The shell execution and system reconnaissance alerts match Markdown labels and billing documentation, not executable instructions. The setup can install a global npm package and pass an API key to a server outside the audited file. No evidence of credential exfiltration or prompt injection was found in the audited file.

remediation.issue: The setup declares a global install of an npm package whose code is outside the audited file.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before installation. Verify the publisher, package integrity, and dependency scripts, then run the reviewed package in an isolated environment without elevated privileges.

remediation.issue: The MCP server receives the PipiAds API key at startup.
remediation.suggestion: Inject the key through the client secret store only after verifying the server. Use a dedicated key with the minimum available permissions and keep it out of logs and prompts.

content.value_statement: A single TikTok ad search cannot show how advertiser activity changes over time. Use dated PipiAds searches to compare results and inspect the creatives behind those changes.
actual_capabilities: Search PipiAds for TikTok ads by region and date range.
Inspect ad details for creative hooks, engagement, and delivery duration.
Find advertisers behind TikTok campaigns and inspect their profiles.
Repeat searches and detail lookups to compare activity across dated results.
Create and review persistent monitoring tasks for Facebook advertisers or stores when requested.
limitations: TikTok comparisons require repeated queries. This MCP server does not offer persistent TikTok monitoring.
Results come from PipiAds and do not replace TikTok Shop product or store analytics.
A configured PipiAds MCP server and API key are required.
Paid search results, paid detail lookups, and successful Facebook monitor creation can consume credits.

use_cases.title: Review Competitor Ad Activity
use_cases.description: Compare TikTok ad results for a competitor across two date ranges in the same region.

use_cases.title: Find Recurring Creative Hooks
use_cases.description: Inspect selected TikTok ads to identify repeated hooks and angles for creative planning.

use_cases.title: Separate TikTok and Facebook Research
use_cases.description: Compare dated TikTok search results and review a requested Facebook monitor in a separate section.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent TikTok Ads
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five TikTok ads for running shoes in Canada over the past seven days. State the date range and filters.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a narrow search in one region.

prompt_templates.title: Review Ad Creatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect these three TikTok ad IDs: [ad IDs]. Summarize each opening hook, reported engagement, and delivery duration where available.
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare known ads without running a broad search.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Date Ranges
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare TikTok ad results for [advertiser] in [region] across [first date range] and [second date range]. Use matching filters and distinguish new results from recurring creatives.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review changes in an advertiser's visible activity.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cross-Platform Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare TikTok results for [brand] in [region] across [date ranges]. Find the matching Facebook page and show the proposed target and credit cost before creating a monitor.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add optional Facebook coverage while keeping TikTok comparisons separate.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare running shoe TikTok ads in Canada for June 1 to 7 and June 8 to 14.
output: Both searches used TikTok, Canada, and the same running shoe keyword.
Two creatives appeared in both result sets. One result in the second period opened with an outdoor product demonstration.
The comparison covers returned ads only. No persistent TikTok monitor was created.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Report on TikTok search results and a separate Facebook monitor for this brand.
output: TikTok search: One creative appeared in both date ranges.
Facebook monitor: The daily overview listed three ads for the selected page.

best_practices: Keep the platform, region, and other filters consistent across date ranges.
Limit paid results and detail lookups to fit your credit budget.
Verify the server package before setup and configure the API key outside chat.
anti_patterns: Using a Facebook monitor as evidence of TikTok activity.
Treating changes in search results as proof that a campaign started or stopped.
Creating or cancelling a Facebook monitor without confirming the target and requested action.

faq.question: Can this skill monitor TikTok continuously?
faq.answer: No. It compares TikTok activity by repeating searches and detail lookups for stated dates and filters.

faq.question: What can it monitor persistently?
faq.answer: It can create persistent tasks for Facebook advertisers or stores when requested.

faq.question: What do I need to use it?
faq.answer: You need a configured PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key.

faq.question: Which actions can use credits?
faq.answer: Paid search results, paid detail lookups, and successful Facebook monitor creation can use credits. The skill documents an exemption for eligible repeat detail queries.

faq.question: Can it compare an advertiser across dates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can repeat searches with matching filters and compare the returned ads and creative details.

faq.question: Can it replace TikTok Shop analytics?
faq.answer: No. It uses PipiAds data for ad research and does not replace TikTok Shop product or store analytics.
